name: Yellow Sigatoka
symptoms: early_stage: Small pale yellow streaks (1–2 mm) on young leaves Chlorotic spots appearing near leaf margins or midrib intermediate_stage: Streaks enlarge into elongated brown lesions Spindle-shaped spots with yellow halos around them advanced_stage: Dark brown to black necrotic spots Large necrotic areas on leaves Premature leaf drying and defoliation
management: cultural_control: Remove infected leaves (de-leafing) Improve plantation sanitation Maintain proper drainage Avoid overcrowding of plants chemical_control: Protectant fungicides Systemic fungicides Products containing tebuconazole, mancozeb, chlorothalonil biological_control: Bacillus subtilis Trichoderma viride Pseudomonas fluorescens preventive_measures: Use tolerant banana varieties Balanced fertilization Regular monitoring of plantations
